BALOCHISTAN CIVIL SERVANTS AND EMPLOYEES BENEFITS AND DEATH
COMPENSATION POLICY, 2020
BALOCHISTAN CIVIL
SERVANTS AND EMPLOYEES BENEFITS AND DEATH COMPENSATION POLICY, 2020
[Gazette of Balochistan
Extraordinary,
11th August, 2020]
No. S.O.FD (R-II)/VII-II/2020/344-443, dated 11.8.2020.---With the prior
approval of the Provincial Cabinet, the Government of Balochistan is pleased to
make the following Policy:-
PART I
GENERAL
1. Short title, application and commencement.---(1) This Policy may
be called the Balochistan Civil Servants and Employees Benefits and Death
Compensation Policy, 2020.
(2) This shall be applicable to a Civil Servant
and Employee or legal heirs of :
(a) in service or died Personnel of Law
Enforcement Agencies (i.e. Police, Levies and Balochistan Constabulary);
(b) all in service or died Civil Servants of the
Government of Balochistan; and
(c) all in service or died employees of
Government of Balochistan;
(3) It shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.---(1) In this Policy,
unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,-
(a) Administrative Secretary means the
Secretary or Acting Secretary to the Government in charge of a Department and
includes, Additional Chief Secretary, Senior Member Board of Revenue and
Chairman Chief Minister s Inspection Team;
(b) Attached Department means a
Department mentioned in column 3 of Schedule II of Balochistan Government Rules
of Business, 2012;
(c) Basic Pay Scale means a Basic Pay
Scale of pay sanctioned by Government in which a post or group of posts is
placed;
(d) Bereaved Family means members of the
family of a deceased employee, who have been wholly dependent and residing with
him permanently.
(e) Compensation means monetary
benefits(s) granted as an aid to the bereaved families.
(f) Chief Secretary means the Chief
Secretary Balochistan;
(g) Civil Servant means as defined in
Section 2 (b) of the Balochistan Civil Servants Act, 1974;
(h) Compensation package means a
monetary benefit granted to the Families of Civil Servants and Employees who
dies or injured while in Service as a result of terrorist activity.
(i) Competent Authority means the
authority competent to sanction compensation as defined in Section 17 of this
policy;
(j) Death Compensation means an amount
approved by the Government, to be paid to the family of a deceased civil
servant on his death during service;
(k) Department means a self-contained
administrative unit in the Secretariat shown in Column 2 of Schedule II of the
Balochistan Government Rules of Business, 2012: provided that Services and
General Administration Department shall, for the purpose of Secretariat
employees, be deemed as a Department;
(l) Deputy Commissioner means a
District Head of the Administration appointed by the Government.
(m) District Compensation Committee means
a Committee constituted under Section 13 of this Policy.
(n) Divisional Commissioner means the
Commissioner of a Division appointed under Section 8 of the West Pakistan Land
Revenue Act, 1967 (Act No.XVII of 1967).
(o) Employee means,
(i) any person who is a member of a civil
service of the Province, or who holds a civil post in connection with the
affairs of the Province;
(ii) any person appointed to the secretarial staff
of the Provincial Assembly whose terms and conditions of service are governed
by rules or Law made under the Constitution;
(iii) Any employee of such Department, Body
Corporate, Institution, Organization or Autonomous Body, as the Provincial
Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, specify, and includes
any such person, officer, servant or member of the staff who is:
(a) On deputation elsewhere or on foreign service
within the meanings of the Fundamental Rules,
(b) Undergoing study or training in or outside
Province/Pakistan,
(c) On duty or on leave within or outside the
Province/Pakistan, or
(d) Under orders of suspension, but does not
